description: Returns every field calculate_osvc_taxes accepts, grouped the way the web calculator groups them, with the same label and explanation shown in its tooltips. Use this to explain an option to the user before they've decided on a value, without running a calculation.

locale.description: Language for the returned explanation text.

name: get_field_guide

disclaimer.description: The not-tax-advice notice to show alongside results.

default.description: The value used when the field is left out.

group.description: Where the web app shows the field: core, extra options, credits and deductions, or rest of the year.

help.description: What the field means and how to fill it in.

key.description: The field's name in the request body. Credit fields are written `credits.name`.

label.description: The field's label, as in the web app.

options.description: The allowed values, for enum fields.

label.description: What that value means, as shown in the web app.

value.description: The value to send, with its JSON type: a number for pausalBand, a string otherwise.

type.description: The kind of value the field takes. `array` is the invoices list, whose item shape the help text gives.

title: Get OSVČ calculator field guide
